products.name: Credo AI
products.note: Purpose-built AI governance; policy packs for EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF; clean interface; fast deployment

profile_text.body:
Credo AI is an enterprise software company focused on AI governance, offering a platform it describes as purpose-built to help organizations discover AI systems, enforce policies, manage risk, and demonstrate regulatory compliance across models, agents, and applications. The company describes itself as having created the AI governance category and says its platform is now oriented toward what it calls the agentic era, covering agents as governed entities alongside traditional models and applications. The platform is built around a Knowledge Graph that the company says fuses regulatory intelligence with customer business context, supported by over 300 integrations and a network of forward-deployed experts. A built-in assistant called GAIA (Govern AI Assistant) is described as compressing weeks of governance work into hours.

The platform includes pre-built policy packs covering the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001, which the company says were written by team members involved in standards-setting bodies including ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and the OECD. Customers quoted on the site include Mastercard and IBM, the latter in connection with a collaboration on Compliance Accelerators. One unnamed customer states that using the platform accelerated EU AI Act compliance at roughly ten times the speed of a manual approach.

The held facts note that the product is tracked under the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category and is characterized by fast deployment and a clean interface. The company's site reports that Fast Company ranked Credo AI number six in Applied AI on its World's Most Innovative Companies of 2026 list, alongside Google, Nvidia, OpenAI, and Anthropic. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records appear in the available data.
